description: Erection of a part single storey, part two storey extension to the side and rear to include a hip to gable roof extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed part single storey, part two storey extension to include a hip to gable roof extension, by reason of its siting in close proximity to the side boundary, its size, scale, bulk, and design, including the hip to gable roof extension and large crown roof, would constitute an unsympathetic and discordant addition, which would fail to harmonise with the architectural composition of the original semi-detached dwelling, would be detrimental to the character, appearance and symmetry of the pair of semi-detached houses of which it forms a part and to the visual amenities of the street scene and the wider East and West Walk Area of Special Local Character. Therefore the proposal would be contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policies BE1 and HE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012) and Policies DMHB 1, DMHB 5,  DMHB 11 and DMHB 12  of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
